title: Electronic Transactions Act (Commencement) Order, 2005
text:
No. 119] Electronic Transactions 1
BELIZE:
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT
No. 119 of 2005
______
ORDER made by the Attorney General in exercise of the powers conferred
upon him by section 2 of the Electronic Transactions Act, Chapter
290:01 of the Substantive Laws of Belize, Revised Edition 2000-2003,
and all other powers thereunto him enabling.
(Gazetted 1st October, 2005.)
1. This Order may be cited as the
Short title.
ELECTRONIC TRANSACTIONS ACT
(COMMENCEMENT) ORDER, 2005.
2. In exercise of the powers conferred upon me by section 2 of the Commencement
Electronic Transactions Act, Chapter 290:01 of the Substantive Laws of Belize, of CAP. 290:01.
Revised Edition 2000-2003, and all other powers thereunto me enabling I,
FRANCIS FONSECA, Attorney General and Minister of Education, Youth,
Sports and Culture, do hereby appoint the 26th day of September, 2005, as the
day on which the said Act shall come into force.
MADE this 23rd day of September, 2005.
(FRANCIS FONSECA)
Attorney General
Minister of Education,
Youth, Sports And Culture
